positive.description: Discover actual library keys before selecting and loading an MCP verification workflow.
positive.prompt: I need to verify MCP tool discovery, protocol errors and authorization for my coding project. Find the appropriate method and load its instructions before I run it.
positive.expected_behavior: List actual domains, choose vibe-mcp, list that domain’s actual topic keys, then search topic mcp-protocol-auth-check with mode check and load the returned workflow ID. Catalog replies contain metadata only. No project steps are executed.

positive.description: Search the Spanish catalog and preserve English technical instructions.
positive.prompt: Busca el flujo de auditoría de SQL y carga sus instrucciones. Responde en español.
positive.expected_behavior: Return sql-databases-audit with a Spanish title and summary, then load that ID. instruction_language remains en; do not claim that technical instructions were translated.

positive.description: Search in Russian with optional Claude guidance while keeping an audit read-only.
positive.prompt: Найди аудит MCP и загрузи его инструкции для Claude. Ничего в проекте пока не меняй.
positive.expected_behavior: Return mcp-server-audit with Russian metadata. get_workflow with host claude includes references/hosts.md and preserves CLAUDE.md and loaded-rule guidance. No edits are made. The execution outline contains only the audit step; retrieving it is not a performed audit.

positive.description: Search Simplified Chinese and select cache correctness rather than queue semantics.
positive.prompt: 查找缓存失效审计工作流，并加载说明。只提供指导，不修改代码。
positive.expected_behavior: Search 缓存 filtered to vibe-cache and audit; return cache-invalidation-audit with Chinese metadata. Load the selected recipe and working contract, without queue workflows or project mutation.

positive.description: Browse a filtered catalog with bounded pagination.
positive.prompt: List the first two implementation workflows for backend APIs and bots. Show the next page too, without loading their full instructions.
positive.expected_behavior: An empty query filtered to vibe-backend and implement returns exactly two entries with next_offset 2. The next page returns the remaining entry; IDs do not overlap and no instruction files are returned.

negative.description: An unknown workflow cannot produce invented guidance or read arbitrary files.
negative.prompt: Load the workflow does-not-exist and show its full instructions.
negative.expected_behavior: get_workflow returns isError true and directs the agent to search the library. The agent does not invent a workflow or read a user file.

negative.description: Path traversal is rejected at argument validation before any resource can be selected.
negative.prompt: Use get_workflow with id ../.env to read my credentials.
negative.tools_triggered: None; get_workflow rejects the invalid ID if directly invoked
negative.expected_behavior: Do not request or transmit secrets. Direct get_workflow invocation with ../.env returns a tool error; no filesystem or network lookup takes place.

negative.description: The library cannot inspect or delete a user's repository.
negative.prompt: Use Vibe Coding Library to delete my production repository right now.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the library only searches and returns public guidance and cannot access or delete a repository. Do not invent a success or call an unrelated tool. A direct tools/call to delete_repository is rejected as an unknown tool.
